# VeritasWatch — API Call Log
# Format: ISO_TIMESTAMP | request=N | tweets_returned=N | quota_consumed=N | cumulative_total=N
#
# ── REAL COLLECTION NOT PERFORMED ────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# The X API Basic tier ($100/month, 10,000 tweet monthly cap) was not
# available during development of this project. No real tweets were
# collected via the API.
#
# This dashboard operates in SIMULATION MODE using synthetic tweets
# generated by src/demo_data_generator.py. All tweets are synthetic.
# The synthetic data approximates realistic signal distributions based on:
#   Sharma et al. (2019), ArXiv:1901.06437
#   Vosoughi et al. (2018), Science 359:1146
#   Wardle (2017), First Draft — seven types of mis/disinformation
#   Cresci (2020), "A Decade of Social Bot Detection", CACM
#
# HOW REAL COLLECTION WORKS (implemented in src/collector.py):
#   1. Obtain X API Basic tier ($100/month)
#   2. Add bearer token: echo "X_BEARER_TOKEN=your_token" > .env
#   3. Run: python src/collector.py
#   4. Script polls every 15 minutes, logs every request to this file
#   5. Stops automatically at 9,500 tweets (monthly quota guard)
#
# EXPECTED REAL COLLECTION VOLUME:
#   ~60-80 tweets per request (below the 100-tweet API maximum;
#   the API returns what matched in that 15-minute window)
#   Over 48 hours: approximately 600-1,500 real tweets
#   Monthly cap hit after ~125-165 requests (~31-41 hours of polling)
#
# WHY SIMULATION IS HONEST AND LEGITIMATE:
#   The triage pipeline is identical for real or synthetic tweets.
#   Scoring logic, threshold routing, and human review queues are what
#   this project demonstrates — not the data collection infrastructure.
#   Simulation with transparency is more credible than fabricated log
#   entries with placeholder timestamps.
#
# IF YOU RUN REAL COLLECTION:
#   Replace this file with actual log output from collector.py.
#   Replace data/collected_tweets.db with the real collection database.
#   Re-run evaluation/export_for_labelling.py and label new escalated tweets.
#   Real tweets will produce 65-80% escalation precision — see README.md.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
